context-vista is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A right-side floating panel and /context command for DeepSeek Harness — a live donut chart of context token usage, allocation, and estimated cost.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d3cff205a04f21569db1.html
